We apologise for the inconvenience. ## When to visit - - - ### Musée du Louvre The museum is open today from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. - 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Monday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday - 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. Wednesday and Friday - Closed Tuesday **Last entry:** 1 hour before closing **Clearing of rooms:** 30 minutes before closing **Public holidays:** the Louvre is closed on 1 January, 1 May and 25 December. It remains open on all other public holidays unless they fall on a Tuesday, the museum’s day of closure. **The Cour Napoléon** is open from 7:30 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. **The Cour Carrée** is currently closed. ### Tuileries Garden - 7:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. January, February, March, November and December - 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. April, May, September and October - 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. June, July, August

Tuileries Garden

Visitors will be asked to vacate the premises 30 minutes before closing There are two public toilets located in the Tuileries Garden, both free and accessible during the garden’s opening hours. They can be found near the entrance on Place de la Concorde and near the entrance on Rue de Rivoli, across from Rue du 29 Juillet.  Four additional public toilets are available during the summer. All public toilets are accessible for persons with reduced mobility.  ### Musée national Eugène-Delacroix - 12:00 p.m. to 5:30 p.m. Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday - 10:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Saturday and Sunday
Entrance fees

**Louvre-Delacroix combined ticket:**  A ticket gives you access to the permanent collections and temporary exhibitions of the Louvre, as well as to the Eugène-Delacroix National Museum the same day and the day after your visit of the Louvre museum.   **Public holidays:** the Musée national Eugène-Delacroix is closed on 1 January, 1 May and 25 December. It remains open on all other public holidays unless they fall on a Tuesday, the museum’s day of closure. Special evening openings until 8:30 PM, depending on programming. See events calendar (in French). See website of Musée National Eugène-Delacroix  ## Ticket prices ### Ticket A ticket gives you access to the permanent collections and temporary exhibitions at the Louvre, as well as same-day or next-day admission to the Musée National Eugène-Delacroix. . Tickets may be purchased on site when museum attendance is low (subject to availability). #### Watch out for ticket fraud! Watch out for ticket fraud: stay vigilant when buying your tickets for the Musée du Louvre.  Beware of the current increase in mirror sites. Do not purchase any tickets that supposedly allow you to jump the queue, and never buy your tickets from illicit street vendors.  If you do, you may be refused entry to the museum.

#### **Time-slot bookings are recommended, including for free-admission visitors.** ###### Admission is free for the following visitors: **Under 18s** Proof of ID required. **Under 26 year-old citizens of the European Economic Area**  with a valid photographic ID **Under 26 year-old residents of the European Economic Area**  with a valid photographic and residency permit longer than 90 days with name and photograph **All visitors** On the first Friday of the month after 6 p.m. (except in July and August) * * * ###### And: **Disabled visitors and the person accompanying them** **Teachers of art, art history, applied arts, design, architecture and archaeology (from any EEA country)** Upon presentation of a valid card or a stamped and signed statement for the current school year, indicating the subject taught, alongside a photographic ID. **ICOM members** Present valid membership card. **Journalists** Present national or international press card. **Job seekers and residents of the European Economic Area** Present proof of entitlement (dated within the last year or indicating a period of validity). **People on income support residents of the European Economic Area** Present proof of entitlement (valid for less than 6 months). #### Citizens and residents (bearing residence permit or >3 months visa) of the following countries: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden #### Free admission The Louvre is free for all visitors on the first Friday of the month after 6 p.m. (except in July and August) and on 14 July! Book a ticket on https://ticket.louvre.fr/en    #### Admission and exit Think ahead of everything you would like to do at the museum as any exit is final. #### Rates applicable as of 14 January 2026 Download.pdf (141,7Ko) ### Tours & activities
